page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-highmem-48 is a memory-optimized server instance belonging to the c4n family. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8581C processor running at 2.3 GHz, built on the x86_64 architecture. This configuration includes 24 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, providing 2.0 threads per core. The processor is equipped with a 260 MB L3 cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and 48 KB L1d cache. It supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for deep learning acceleration. The instance is provisioned with 372.0 GB of system memory, yielding 7.75 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong performance across multiple domains. In single-core processing, the instance achieves top-tier results in Geekbench single-core, image processing, and text processing. Multi-core performance is also robust, with a Passmark CPU score of 56797.87 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 19286.0. Memory performance is mixed; while small-block cached read bandwidth is highly competitive at 3887.58 GB/sec, large-block uncached reads and writes fall into the average tier. Cryptographic and compression tasks perform exceptionally well, as evidenced by strong bzip3 decompression speeds and a high Passmark CPU encryption score. For AI workloads, the hardware-assisted AMX instructions enable strong prompt processing speeds for small and medium LLM models, though text generation speeds for medium models remain average.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the c4n-highmem-48 offers a dense memory-to-vCPU ratio suitable for memory-intensive workloads without the overhead of a fully dedicated bare-metal system. However, the lack of bundled local storage means users must provision external block storage, which represents a key architectural tradeoff. The instance is highly suited for memory-bound applications, software compilation, static web serving, and moderate language model inference. It is also well-suited for database operations and data processing tasks that fit within its 372 GB memory footprint.
